entries.prompt: Create ONE standalone game-art object: a heavy vertical sliding iron mine gate in its CLOSED position, fully visible, centered and nearly square. Orthographic straight-on FRONT VIEW for a 2D cave cross-section, not isometric. Match the hand-painted outlined warm-earth and slate-blue material style in @mine, but draw only this gate, not the reference sheet. Rough dark oak side posts and a chunky lintel, battered blue-black wrought iron bars, a few aged brass rivets, subtle ochre highlights from upper left, restrained greenish oxidized patina. Four thick vertical bars and two horizontal crosspieces, readable dark gaps between them, obvious physical weight. The sliding gate should be clearly different from the existing wooden exit door. Include a small blank brass identification plate, with NO letter or number. Bold readable silhouette and broad material shapes at 64px; rich painterly texture at large scale. All of the gate including frame must fit within the image with 10 percent margin. No scenery, no wall beyond the frame, no floor, no text, no interface borders. Flat dark charcoal #101b20 background. This is a production design draft, single object, no collage.

entries.prompt: Paint ONE functional mining lever as a game object, orthographic straight-on front view, matching the warm outlined hand-painted wood and metal style of @mine. A SINGLE long slim iron lever arm points diagonally up-left from ONE circular brass pivot near the lower center. At the far tip of the arm is ONE small rounded ochre wooden handgrip, inline with the arm. The handle shape must read unmistakably as a pull lever. NO hammer head, NO axe, NO pickaxe, NO horizontal crossbar at the tip, NO second handle. The pivot is bolted to a roughly square weathered oak mounting block with four blue-black iron bolts. Subtle gear teeth only around the bottom pivot, a small blank brass label below it. Keep details simple: at 40px the diagonal arm, handgrip, pivot and wooden mount must remain distinct. Slate-blue iron, warm chestnut wood, aged brass, light from upper left. Full object centered with generous empty margins, no background scenery, no floor, no text or numbers, flat charcoal background #101b20. One lever in one pose, not a sheet, not isometric, not a 3D render.
